capabilities.name: RFC 8785 canonical JSON encoding
capabilities.description: RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 encoding with golden number, ordering, Unicode and negative-zero vectors.
limitations: Only a Python reference implementation exists; cross-language conformance has not been tested.

capabilities.name: Strict UTF-8 JSON decoding
capabilities.description: Strict UTF-8 decoding rejects malformed JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers and invalid Unicode; payloads, nesting and containers are bounded.
limitations: Schema-bound AIX message validation remains a separate integration concern.

capabilities.name: Cross-language codec conformance
capabilities.description: Shared vectors and independent implementations will verify byte-identical canonicalization across languages.
limitations: No second-language implementation or cross-language conformance suite exists yet.

explicit_non_capabilities: Schema registry publication or compatibility enforcement
Private model reasoning or chain-of-thought serialization
